_comment: Terms VERIFIED absent (normalized whole-word search) from the extracted text of each source. Revalidated by tests/verify_citations.py. 'ocrg' = absent only from the OCRG; 'asvs' = absent only from the ASVS; 'ambos' (both) = absent from both. Terms whose CONCEPT appears under another spelling (e.g. IDOR spelled out, click jacking, two-factor) were deliberately excluded.
